messages:
Ravi: Quick sync about the JS SDK publish strategy. We need a single npm package that works in Node (CJS), modern Node ESM, and edge runtimes (Cloudflare/Deno/Vercel).
Clara: Agreed. Key ask from UX: sample apps should work OOTB on Next Edge + Cloudflare Workers without polyfills.
Tess: My take: emit two bundles (cjs + esm) plus one unified types bundle. Use conditional exports to route `import` vs `require`. Keep package surface stable.
Ravi: Important nuance: TypeScript older versions don't honor `exports` for `.d.ts`. We should keep top-level "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" AND fold types into exports for newer clients.
Clara: Also add `typesVersions` fallback for TS <4.5? Some enterprise teams are still on 4.4.
Tess: Example export block I prototyped (slightly different):
Tess: ```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
Anya: Edge runtime rule-of-thumb: avoid `fs`, `net`, `tls`. Use `globalThis.crypto` + `fetch`. For Node-only features, lazy-load with `if (typeof window === 'undefined')` or conditional exports.
buildbot: CI: nightly builds now output `dist/esm`, `dist/cjs`, `dist/types`; artifacts at https://ci.internal/redsdk/1798.
Ravi: Auth and fetch: prefer `fetch` when available. Node should default to `undici` or `node-fetch` depending on Node version. But expose `fetchImplementation` option so integrators can inject custom fetch (for eg xhr shims).
Clara: Retry behavior debate: browsers/edge shouldn't do aggressive retry by default (can blow up cross-origin requests). Let's default to 1 retry for edge, 2 for Node, and expose `retry` override. Document deterministic backoff.
Tess: Bundler friendliness: ensure ESM build is free of Node polyfills. Add `sideEffects: false` in package.json and small `exports` hints so webpack/rollup tree-shake. Also provide svelte/next examples under `examples/edge-app` to catch issues.
Anya: Types detail: produce a single `dist/types/index.d.ts` that uses conditional types to reflect runtime differences (overloads for browser options). Keep it simple so dts consumers don't need deep imports.
Ravi: CI test matrix request: add job matrix for Node LTS (CJS), Node ESM, webpack bundle test, rollup build, Cloudflare Wrangler smoke test, Deno import test. Fail CI if ESM build contains `require(` or `fs` references.
Clara: Minor: update README with explicit note about Authorization header and browser credentials: "Set fetch `credentials: 'omit'` if you don't want cookies; SDK sets `Authorization: Bearer <key>` by default."
Tess: Action items:
- @Tess update rollup/tsconfig to output `dist/{cjs,esm,types}` + add `types` top-level field
- @Anya add Cloudflare + Deno smoke examples under `examples/edge-app` and CI job
- @Ravi draft compatibility page for types & exports pitfalls (TS <4.5 notes)
- @Clara add retry config & document browser defaults

Ravi: Cool, let's try to have a prototype branch with CI passing by EOW. Ping me for pairing on conditional export edge-cases. :thumbsup:
